description: Symptom: required SMTP limits accept blank input and save successfully. Owner/invariant: shared FileSettings validation must reject unresolved required effective limits regardless of delivery support; persistence must remain atomic with field-local form errors. Jad explicitly approved changing the existing unsupported-SMTP success expectations in the current conversation. Action reuse assessment: extend existing FileSettings.validate/2 and reuse ChannelConfig prepare_changes, EmailConfig cached validation, and EmailConnectorSettings/SaveEmailConnector persistence; no new Action, endpoint, tool, or validation copy. Contract: blank required unresolved limits fail; positive supplied values or known transport defaults pass; optional blanks and unsupported transports with no required metadata retain their behavior. Plan: add focused failing unit/property and persistence/form regressions; fix shared predicate; update approved contradictory tests/fixtures and owner documentation; run affected suites and mix q. No new feature E2E needed for validation-only regression with LiveView coverage. Preserve prior uncommitted changes. No precommit restart, commit, push, or publication.
